concept.title: What Are Cookies
concept.shortdesc: Cookies are small packets of data that web servers send to a device’s browser.

conbody.p: When you visit a website, your web server transfers a small packet of data to your device’s browser called a computer cookie. This cookie is designed to remember information about you, including a record of your website visits and activity. This information helps enhance the website’s usability and tailor its experience to you.
